scope: First fixed measurement of the active formal foundation policy. Case selection is local engineering sampling, not claimed to be SCUT published test results or a newly approved pass threshold.
checkpoint_selection: First intact registered ordinary checkpoint with infos.successful_updates_total >= 500; check metadata, not file name.

coverage.training_source_command_frame: body-forward plus yaw; no claim of world-fixed translation while spinning

boundary.outcomes: Report boundary truncations and actual observation time independently of physical terminations; do not infer 20s sustained capability from boundary exits.

pass_thresholds: Not assigned: report velocity/yaw/height error, spin-center drift/periodic orbit, translation heading drift, terminal causes, observations and durations for review.
